text: {"name":"conn_rx","confidence":"high","docstring":"Handles a received 802.11 frame for a connection/channel, validating RF channel and PHY state, updating RX counters and packet descriptors under IRQ critical sections, and storing hardware timestamps.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"a1":"frame_desc","a2":"conn_idx","v4":"rx_conn_state","v5":"rf_channel","v6":"channel_context_base","v7":"pkt_control","v8":"rf_channel_context","v11":"frame_control_byte","v12":"current_rx_pkt","v13":"channel_expected_pkt","v14":"rx_irq_counter","v15":"llcp_pending","v19":"hw_timestamp","v30":"rx_pkt_desc"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":28,"meaning":"frame_desc: RF channel index"},{"offset":72,"meaning":"frame_desc: associated RX packet descriptor pointer"},{"offset":76,"meaning":"frame_desc: RX packet control pointer"},{"offset":20,"meaning":"rx_conn_state: RX packet descriptor linked/initialized flag"},{"offset":44,"meaning":"rx_conn_state: pending LLC/TX LLCP handling flag"},{"offset":80,"meaning":"rx_conn_state: per-receive byte counter"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"rf_channel_context: channel ready/active flag"},{"offset":120,"meaning":"rf_channel_context: captured hardware timestamp"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"rx_pkt_desc/current_rx_pkt: 802.11 frame-control word low byte"}]}
